description: Phase 3.2a, screen 13: a past check-in. The app sends log.set_value with date_mode backdate and the chosen local date in log_date (ASSUMPTION(A3.1-backdate-payload)); occurred_at is the real moment of the write, never invented. The server files it under log_date and acks resolved_date = log_date.
rules: local_date_hint equals log_date, so the device files the provisional value under the chosen day
occurred_at is the time of the write; it is not moved into the chosen day
a log_date older than 30 local days or after the local today is rejected (backdate_too_old, backdate_future)
